# Ace City Inc.

Ace City Inc. is a Truck Transportation company. Ace City Inc. is a trucking service company based in Milton, Ontario. They offer a dedicated run and trailer drop facility for shipments to the USA and Ontario. With over 30 years of experience, they provide the best customer service. Ace City Inc. employs 5 people (-5.6% YoY, -1 person), founded in 2005. Headquartered in Milton, Ontario, Canada, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across Canada and India.

## About

Ace City, based in Milton Ontario, is a recognized player in transportation and distribution across North America. Our services offerings provide flexibility and consistent performance for your truckload and less-than-truckload shipping needs. We provide transportation services within Canada and cross border to East and Mid-West United States.

Truck Driver Jobs Milton, Toronto, Ontario

# AZ Truck Driver Jobs in Ontario

## Truck Driver Job Openings in Milton

Working with Ace City, you can count on coming home each night/weekend to see your family. Our routes run through Ontario to BC, Quebec, Manitoba, Calgary and other states of Canada and cross-border to the Mid-West United States. There are some long-haul trips trans border (US) and local Canadian trips and local city loads (shunt drivers) as well, but we make sure you’re well prepared for the road ahead.

We are looking for suitable and experienced AZ truck drivers to join our team at our Milton office in Ontario. As a Truck Driver with Ace City, your experience is unmatched. We value your contributions as a member of our team and we make sure you feel it. Come be a part of our team and put your talent and skill to great benefits for you and Ace City. You must have minimum 1 year work experience as a AZ Driver. If you are living in or planning to move to Milton, Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Toronto, GTA, Hamilton, Burlington, Markham, Richmond Hills, Vaughan, Etobicoke, Guelph, Kitchener etc., and looking for trucking jobs in Ontario, you have reached the right place and this truck driver job could be for yours. Currently, Ace City is looking for AZ Drivers long haul for Northwest United States, BC and Montreal (Western Canada) lanes and city drivers (shunt drivers to move loads between Toronto GTA and our yard in Milton).
